cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I will handle the inquiry into the missing keys. What exactly did the manager tell you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She thinks they're in the drain. Can I tell her you locked up?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll approve the wording after you've told me why she suspects the drain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone saw you kneeling beside it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may quote that observation exactly. Did they see anything in my hands?
